pages.title: Overkill: Top Down Arcade Shooter
pages.creator: Saturn Game Studio
pages.description:
Overkill: Top Down Arcade Shooter puts a lone fighter in an arena filled with waves of enemies. Fire into the crowds while moving around incoming threats, then push through the game's combat sectors. Survival depends on keeping up your attacks while leaving yourself room to dodge.

As you progress, unlock weapons and improve their damage, firing speed, and range. These upgrades give you more ways to handle the enemy waves, making your growing arsenal part of the challenge alongside movement and shooting.

pages.title: Ghosty Bubble
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description:
Ghosty Bubble combines bubble shooting with a slot-machine mechanic. Drag to line up a shot, then release to fire a bubble and make a matching group of three. Dropped bubbles fill the slot pot, activating a spin that can produce a jackpot and clear a large number of bubbles.

Obstacle bubbles threaten to cover the pot, so clearing them matters as well as making matches. You can also collect treasures from a gacha machine to unlock bubbles that award more points.

pages.title: School simulator: My school
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
School simulator: My school is a management game about expanding a school and providing the facilities its students need. Open classrooms, add toilets and a canteen, and hire staff to help run the school and support learning.

New classrooms attract more pupils, and a larger student population brings in more money. Put those earnings back into the school to develop it further. The central loop connects building, staffing, and student growth, with each expansion creating opportunities for the next.

pages.title: Color Block Blast 3
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Color Block Blast 3 is an endless matching puzzle played on a grid. Drag blocks into position to bring together at least three tiles of one color and remove them from the board. The aim is to keep making matches and raise your score.

Combos award bonus points, making the arrangement of each block important to your score.

pages.title: Idle Trade Routes
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Idle Trade Routes lets you manage merchant ships carrying goods between islands. Connect ports with trade routes and organize a growing fleet, with ships docking automatically as they move goods through your network.

Use the profits to obtain more ships, hire captains, and take on larger contracts. Adjusting the trade lines is part of growing the business: the goal is to keep goods moving as your fleet expands. The idle system also allows the trading operation to earn while you are away.

pages.title: Echolocation Shooter
pages.creator: Shout Games
pages.description:
Echolocation Shooter is a first-person survival game in which firing a weapon also reveals your surroundings. Sound waves from your shots expose the dark arena and its neon enemies, so attacking and seeing the battlefield are connected.

Fight through repeated waves using weapons such as soundwave rifles, laser cannons, and grenades. Upgrade your equipment as you face the horde, and use the information revealed by each attack to locate threats. The challenge comes from fighting enemies when the environment is otherwise hidden.

pages.title: Zip Zap
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Zip Zap is a physics puzzle about moving mechanical structures onto targets. Tap to contract their hinges, then release to let the parts move. Your timing creates momentum, tips the structure, and lets gravity influence where it goes.

Complete a stage by touching its white circles or reaching the marked target area. Rather than steering a character directly, you work with the structure's motion. Watch how its parts respond and time the next contraction or release to guide them toward the goal.

pages.title: Block Puzzle: Slide Block Jam
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description:
Block Puzzle: Slide Block Jam challenges you to slide colored blocks to exits of the same color. Clear every block from the grid before the timer expires, working out which moves will bring each piece to its destination.

The matching exits give every block a specific goal, while the clock limits how long you can spend planning. Look over the arrangement before moving and keep track of the blocks still on the board as you work toward a complete clear.

pages.title: Formula Racers
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description:
Formula Racers is an arcade racing game viewed from above. Compete across ten tracks while the game tracks your laps and current position in the race. The focus is on driving through each circuit and improving your place in the field.

Earn coins to unlock more cars and upgrade their components. Engine, gearbox, steering, and brake upgrades give you several parts of the car to develop between races. Progress combines racing on the circuits with spending your earnings on the vehicle you bring back to the track.

pages.title: Parking Frenzy
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Parking Frenzy turns parking into a route-drawing puzzle. Swipe to trace a path for the car, then let it follow the line toward its parking space. Study the 3D environment and decide how the car should approach its destination. Success depends on the route you draw and when you set the car moving.

pages.title: Steampunk Merge To Battle
pages.creator: GamesdMurdock
pages.description:
Steampunk Merge To Battle is a castle-conquering strategy game built around combining troops. Bring warriors and archers into battle, merge two units into a stronger fighter, and use your army to capture the castles blocking your advance.

You can also build up your own castle and improve your troops. Each victory moves you to the next level, connecting battlefield decisions with army development. Choose when to strengthen units and how to use the forces you have as you work through the opposing defenses.

pages.title: Fish Shooting Fish Hunter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Fish Shooting Fish Hunter is a fishing game where you aim at swimming fish and tap to shoot and catch them. Each level has its own catch requirements, giving you particular targets to pursue as you explore the underwater areas around different islands.

Sell the fish you bring back and spend the gold on equipment upgrades, including oxygen gear and fishing rods. Completing levels opens access to more islands, so catching the required fish and improving your gear are both part of advancing through the game.

pages.title: Ball Rolling Slope
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description:
Ball Rolling Slope is a 3D arcade game about keeping a rolling ball on an endless downhill course. Guide it along steep, neon-lit slopes, avoid obstacles, and watch for sudden drops as you work toward a higher score.

Accurate steering and quick reactions are central to the challenge. Look ahead at the next section of the slope so you can adjust your route before the ball reaches a hazard.

pages.title: Hard Rock Zombie Truck
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Hard Rock Zombie Truck puts you on the roof of a truck in a 2D zombie shooter. Clear crowds of undead creatures and other monsters with gunfire, explosions, and crushing attacks, while protecting the living people caught in the chaos.

Upgrade your weapons and abilities to improve your fighting power. The combination of destroying monsters and saving survivors gives you two things to watch during the action: the enemies you need to stop and the people you must keep alive.

pages.title: Tip Tap!
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description:
Tip Tap! is a physics puzzle game in which you move a ball or a movable plate to reach a smiling emoji. Getting to the target completes the level, but you must keep from falling over an edge along the way.

The levels become more demanding as you progress, putting more emphasis on precision and timing. Watch how your movements affect the ball and plate, and make controlled adjustments to bring the ball toward its goal.

pages.title: Turbo Race
pages.creator: Felicity Games
pages.description:
Turbo Race is a car racing game that takes you through different locations with their own driving challenges. Keep your car on the track, guide it around tight turns, and avoid obstacles along the route.

On a desktop, steer by moving your mouse cursor; the car follows the direction you indicate. Careful cursor movements help you line up for bends and maintain your path through the changing courses.

pages.title: Sword Run 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Sword Run 3D combines running with cutting through obstacles. Collect sword pieces as you move along the course, then use your blade to clear the barriers blocking your route. Your objective is to reach the finish line, and the game also offers skins to unlock.

pages.title: Block TNT Blast
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Block TNT Blast is a demolition sandbox in which you place bombs to destroy objects. Decide where to set your explosives, blast the targets apart, and earn diamonds from the destruction.

Those diamonds let you unlock more powerful bombs, linking the demolition to a wider choice of explosives. Think about where a blast will do the most useful damage as you work through the objects you want to demolish.

pages.title: Christmas Block Challenge
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Christmas Block Challenge is a holiday block puzzle played on a 10-by-10 board. Place festive blocks to complete full rows or columns, collecting the Christmas items contained in those lines. Clearing every collectible from the board is your objective.

A useful placement needs to do more than fill an empty space: it should help complete a line containing an item you still need. Plan around those targets while leaving room for the blocks that follow.

pages.title: Kingdom Survivor
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Kingdom Survivor is a combat survival game set in a world overrun by demons and other monsters. You fight alone, using weapons to destroy enemy hordes and stay alive. With creatures all around you and no safe hiding place, the focus is on confronting the threats and surviving the battle.

pages.title: You Hit Me!
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description:
You Hit Me! is a puzzle game built around an unusual choice: sacrificing teammates to solve a level. Switch between characters and work out how their actions can help you get past each problem. The game also includes different skins and hidden surprises.

Use WASD to move, J to attack, K to jump, and Space to change characters. Consider what each character needs to do before committing to a sacrifice that helps solve the puzzle.

pages.title: Jump or Block Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Jump or Block Colors Game is a reflex challenge for up to four players. Watch the red, spiked needle and choose whether to jump over it or block it. Missing the response means losing, so each encounter depends on choosing your action and timing it correctly.

pages.title: Tangram Match Masters
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Tangram Match Masters combines filling a shape with matching colors. Place blocks inside the outlined shape, paying attention to the colored borders on their sides. Wherever blocks touch, the colors along their neighboring edges must agree.

A piece fitting into a gap is only part of the solution. Check its borders against the blocks around it before deciding where it belongs, and work toward filling the whole shape without breaking the color-matching rule.

pages.title: Kill The Zombies
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description:
Kill The Zombies is a first-person shooter that combines fighting undead enemies with searching for a way forward. Shoot the zombies and look for keys that open steel gates, then move through those gates to continue toward the end.

Finishing quickly is part of the challenge. You need to handle the enemies in your path while finding the keys that let you advance, so fighting and searching both matter to a fast completion.

pages.title: Knight Dash
pages.creator: Renan Games
pages.description:
Knight Dash sends you through a castle in search of the key that lets you advance to the next level. Move around the objects scattered along the way and keep looking for the item needed to continue.

Use the arrow keys to move, or guide your character with the mouse or touch controls.

pages.title: Christmas Blocks
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description:
Christmas Blocks gives the falling-block puzzle a Christmas theme. Move and rotate the incoming pieces to fit them into the board, completing horizontal rows to clear space and score points. Clearing lines consecutively builds combos, giving you another reason to plan where each shape will land.

On a keyboard, the left and right arrows shift a piece, Up or X rotates it clockwise, and Z rotates it counterclockwise. Space drops and locks the block, while Control swaps it. Touchscreen players can use the on-screen buttons.

pages.title: Noise Of Bones
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description:
Noise Of Bones is a castle-defense strategy game in which you organize warriors against an invading army of monsters and bosses. Build defensive lines around your castle, set traps, and use special abilities to stop the attackers from taking your kingdom.

Strengthening your army is part of the defense: upgrade your warriors and adapt your approach to enemies with different weapons. The challenge combines troop preparation with the placement of defenses, giving you several tools for dealing with the forces besieging the castle.

pages.title: Silent Asylum
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description:
Silent Asylum traps you inside a monster-filled asylum with a locked exit. Fight through its dark corridors and search for every key needed to open the way out. Shooting the creatures is only part of the task; you also need to keep exploring until you have the keys required to escape.

Move with WASD and fire with the left mouse button. The mouse wheel changes weapons, R reloads, C crouches, and Space jumps, giving you movement and weapon controls as you navigate the asylum.

pages.title: Rocket Stunt Cars
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description:
Rocket Stunt Cars lets you choose between a broad desert stunt map, city traffic, and highway driving. Pick the setting you want to drive in, then take your car onto open stunt terrain or steer through roads shared with other vehicles. Cockpit and third-person cameras offer different views of the drive.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to control the car, F for the NOS boost, and Space to brake. Press C to switch cameras as you move between practicing stunts and navigating traffic.

pages.title: Realistic Parking
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description:
Realistic Parking is a 3D driving simulation built around placing a car inside a marked yellow parking area. Steer toward the designated square and line up the vehicle with the target, using controlled movements to position it.

WASD and the arrow keys provide the driving controls. The garage also contains more vehicles to unlock, so parking different cars becomes part of the game alongside reaching the highlighted spaces.

pages.title: Ski Safari
pages.creator: GamesHeroo
pages.description: Ski Safari is a downhill skiing game centered on fast runs and aerial stunts. Head down the slopes, get airborne, and perform tricks during the descent.

pages.title: Christmas Santa Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Christmas Santa Slide is a sliding-picture puzzle with three Santa-themed images to reconstruct. Choose a picture, then move its tiles around the grid until the separate sections form the complete scene.

Three grid sizes are available: 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5. The larger layouts divide the picture into more sections, while the 3x3 option gives you a smaller puzzle to start with. Use the mouse to play.

pages.title: Drunken Boxing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Drunken Boxing puts two unsteady boxers in an arena, where the objective is to knock out your opponent and become the first to reach five points. Throw quick punches while watching your energy bar, keeping an eye on both the opposing boxer and your available energy.

Choose one-player or two-player mode. Player one uses the arrow keys, and player two uses WASD, allowing two people to share a keyboard. On a touchscreen, the left and right sides provide the controls for the two boxers.

pages.title: Cute Pet Friends
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description:
Cute Pet Friends lets you care for Kiki the cat and Fifi the dog through grooming, dressing, and home-design activities. Give the pets a bubble bath, rinse and clean them, brush their fur, and polish their nails as you work through their care routines.

You can also put together outfits for the pair and build and decorate a house for them. Use the mouse or tap the screen to interact with the pets and the objects used in each activity.

pages.title: Happy Halloween
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description:
Happy Halloween is a matching puzzle where you swipe over items of the same type to clear them from the board. Work toward each level's targets, including removing caskets and bringing bats and ghosts down to the bottom row. You must finish the requirements within the available moves and time.

Four power-ups help with difficult boards. The Hand adds five moves, the Broom removes one character, the Potion clears nine characters, and the Skull clears a horizontal line. Pumpkins, candy, moons, and witch hats give the matching pieces their Halloween theme.

pages.title: Riding Adventure Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Riding Adventure Jigsaw offers twelve pictures to assemble, each with three choices of piece count. Select an image and rebuild it by fitting its jigsaw pieces together, choosing a layout that suits the size of puzzle you want to solve.

Easy mode uses 25 pieces, medium uses 49, and hard uses 100. These options let you revisit a selected image with a more detailed puzzle. Play with the mouse or by tapping the screen.

pages.title: Cars Coloring Game
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description:
Cars Coloring Game is a vehicle-themed coloring book with pictures of cars, trucks, tractors, and other transport. Choose colors for the vehicle drawings and give each picture your own color scheme.

Use the mouse or tap the screen to play. The activity focuses on coloring the supplied pictures, with different types of vehicles providing the subjects.

pages.title: Kart Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Kart Jigsaw turns kart pictures into puzzles that you rebuild piece by piece. Drag the scattered pieces into their correct positions with the mouse, matching the picture as you put it back together.

There are six pictures, and each has three difficulty modes. Completing puzzles earns in-game money, with the hardest mode paying more. Additional pictures cost $1,000 in game currency, so solving puzzles also helps you open more images to assemble. Choose a difficulty based on the challenge you want and the reward you are working toward.

pages.title: Crazy Taxi Simulator
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description:
Crazy Taxi Simulator puts you in a vintage taxi on mountain roads, picking up passengers and taking them to their destinations. Each trip has a time limit, so you need to reach the drop-off safely before the clock runs out.

The mountain terrain makes the route difficult to drive, and an angry elephant adds another hazard along the way. Use the arrow keys or WASD to control the taxi, paying attention to the road while keeping the passenger deadline in mind.

pages.title: Dragon vs Mage
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Dragon vs Mage is an action runner in which you help a mage escape a pursuing dragon. Collect points along the route, avoid obstacles, and shoot at threats that block the escape.

Press the Up arrow to jump and X to shoot. The chase combines movement and attacks: you need to clear the route while continuing to put distance between the mage and the dragon.

pages.title: Bouncing Ball
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description:
Bouncing Ball challenges you to guide a ball along narrow steps and travel as far as possible. The restricted space makes keeping the ball on its route the central task.

Play with the mouse or by tapping the screen. As you progress, different ball types become available to switch between, giving you other balls to use for the distance challenge.

pages.title: Blendy Juicy Simulation
pages.creator: SA Games
pages.description: Blendy Juicy Simulation is a fruit-cutting game about making mixed juice. Cut the fruit to prepare the ingredients for your drink, turning a simple kitchen preparation task into the main activity.

pages.title: Cut Crush Zombies
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description:
In Cut Crush Zombies, a lumberjack named Jack finds zombies blocking his way home after a day of cutting trees. Help him use his axe to defeat them and get back safely.

Combat is supported by upgrades and a shop where you can buy useful items and hire mercenaries. These purchases give you more ways to support Jack against the zombies as you work toward clearing his route home. The game combines axe fighting with decisions about which improvements and helpers to buy.

pages.title: Chick Slot
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description:
Chick Slot is a slot-machine simulation that uses game earnings without requiring a real-money stake. Play the slots and choose whether to attempt to double what you have won.

Use the mouse or touch the screen to interact with the game. The doubling option adds another decision after a win, letting you try to increase those simulated earnings.

pages.title: Easter Mahjong Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Easter Mahjong Deluxe is a timed tile-matching puzzle. Remove identical pairs to clear the board, selecting tiles that have an open side on either the left or the right. A matching picture alone is not enough if the tile is blocked.

Use hints when you need help finding a pair, but consider saving them: unused hints earn a bonus, as does time left on the clock. The goal is to empty the board before time expires while balancing quick matches against the bonuses you can preserve.

pages.title: Assassin VS Zombies
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description:
Assassin VS Zombies is a sword-fighting game with a direct objective: eliminate the zombies. Choose which side to strike and use your sword against the enemies.

Press the screen to attack to the left or right, or use the keyboard arrows. The controls put the emphasis on choosing the direction of each attack as you fight the zombies.

pages.title: Cute Kitty Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description:
Cute Kitty Match 3 asks you to arrange matching kitten blocks in lines of at least three. Build matches to increase your score while watching the meter on the left side of the screen.

The game ends if that meter falls too low, so keeping matches coming is part of the challenge. Use the mouse or tap the screen to play, looking for groups of the same kitten as you try to beat your score.

pages.title: Sky Battle
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description:
Sky Battle is an arcade shooter with enemy ships, mines, missiles, and radioactive barrels to destroy. Along the way, collect stars, drones, life pickups, and improvements to support your attack.

Use the Up and Down arrow keys to move vertically and Shift to fire. Touch controls are also supported. Your task combines shooting through the threats ahead with collecting useful pickups, so positioning matters both for lining up targets and for reaching the items scattered through the battle.

pages.title: Shoot the Guy
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description:
Shoot the Guy is a precision shooting game where careful aim earns powerful shots. Line up your weapon with the target and aim for the head, making each opportunity count.

Touch the screen to change your aim, then release to fire. The challenge is choosing the right angle before letting the shot go, rather than firing without checking your target.

pages.title: Princess Halloween Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare a princess for a costume party in Princess Halloween Party, a dress-up and makeup game with a Halloween theme. Choose from the available outfits, then coordinate the clothing with themed makeup to complete her party appearance. Try different combinations to create a look for the celebration.

pages.title: Sling Race Online
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
Sling Race Online is an arcade driving game about drifting through the corners of an endless track. Keep the car moving around each bend and try to extend your run as far as possible.

Play with the mouse and concentrate on the next turn. Distance is the main goal, so navigating a sequence of corners is the challenge throughout the run.

pages.title: EG Magical Blox
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description:
EG Magical Blox is a block puzzle where you place cube pieces to complete horizontal and vertical lines. Filled lines disappear, opening space for more pieces. Your task is to keep clearing room before the blocks occupy the board.

There is no timer and no requirement to match colors. Take time to compare the available spaces with each piece, and look for placements that complete a row or column while leaving room for what comes next.

pages.title: Avoid
pages.creator: Yupi.io
pages.description:
Avoid is an arcade action game about dodging enemies and obstacles while collecting points. You have to watch for incoming threats and take scoring opportunities without getting caught by the hazards around them.

Collect points before they are destroyed. Paying attention to both the pickups and the nearby dangers is central to the challenge, since chasing a point can distract you from something you need to evade.

pages.title: Wheelie Challenge 2
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Wheelie Challenge 2 is a bike stunt game about keeping the front wheel raised for as long as possible. Tap to perform a wheelie, ride on the rear wheel, and try to extend the length of your attempt.

pages.title: Tanko.io
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description:
Tanko.io is a team tank battle where two groups of five players fight to destroy each other's base. Use your tank's artillery to reduce the opposing base's health while your own team's base remains a target.

The first team to demolish the enemy base wins. That shared objective gives the battle a focus beyond individual tank fights: attacking the opposing base matters, but leaving your own undefended gives the other team the same opportunity.

pages.title: Mountain Hop
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Hop down a hazardous mountainside in Mountain Hop, avoiding cracked ground, poison potions, TNT, and hostile characters. Collect stars during the descent and use them to unlock different animals, including rabbits, sheep, bears, tigers, and elephants.

The route also includes waterfalls that help you move faster. Watch for enemies such as wolves, lions, zombies, and the Grim Reaper while looking for a safe way downward. Each attempt combines avoiding hazards with gathering stars and trying to improve your score.

pages.title: Hitman Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Hitman Rush sends an armed hitman across rooftops filled with enemies. Run through the rooftop encounters and use your guns against the opponents blocking your mission.

Other hitmen can be unlocked as you play, giving you different characters to take into the rooftop action.

pages.title: The Hangman Game Scrawl
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
The Hangman Game Scrawl presents the classic hidden-word puzzle with a doodled character. Choose letters to uncover the missing word, using the revealed positions to decide what to guess next.

A correct guess fills in the matching blanks. A wrong guess costs a life and adds another part to the hangman drawing. Solve the word before too many mistakes complete the picture and end the game.

pages.title: Sketchman Gun
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Sketchman Gun is a doodle-style action game that combines running, jumping, and shooting. Guide the drawn hero through a route filled with obstacles and enemies, using jumps to get past hazards and gunfire against the opponents ahead.

The run keeps the focus on dealing with what comes next. Watch the path and decide when to jump or shoot as Sketchman moves through the illustrated action.

pages.title: Basket Ball Challenge Flick The Ball
pages.creator: webofgrafix
pages.description: Basket Ball Challenge Flick The Ball puts you in control of the basket. Drag the hoop to meet the basketballs and get them through it. Watch each ball's path and adjust the basket's position as it approaches; the challenge is to keep catching balls without missing one.

pages.title: Bow Master Stickman Hero
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description:
Bow Master Stickman Hero is an archery rescue game in which your targets are the ropes holding up captured stick figures. Aim your arrows at those ropes to release the people hanging from them.

Work through the game's rescue challenges by lining up each shot carefully. The objective is to free your fellow stickmen, so concentrate on the rope you need to cut.

pages.title: Stickman Army : The Defenders
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Command an army against an invading force in Stickman Army : The Defenders. Your task is to protect the country's institutions by deploying soldiers and keeping attackers from breaking through your defenses.

Different units have their own strengths, so choosing your troops matters. Collect energy to build units, manage your resources, and adapt your defensive line to the enemies approaching it. The battle depends on how effectively you organize your army and stop the advance.

pages.title: Princess Anti Fashion: Sporty + Classy
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description:
Princess Anti Fashion: Sporty + Classy is a dress-up game about combining two clothing styles in one outfit. Join Jasmine, Anna, and Aurora as they mix athletic pieces with smarter clothes for their Anti-Fashion Show.

Choose combinations that bring sporty and classy items together instead of keeping each look within a single style. Your task is to create outfits for the three princesses around that mixed-fashion theme.

pages.title: Vintage Five Difference
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Vintage Five Difference asks you to compare two nearly identical pictures and find the five details that do not match. Examine both images carefully, checking small features as well as more obvious changes.

Finding all five differences opens the next level and gives you another pair of pictures to inspect. There is no time limit, so you can work through each scene at your own pace.

pages.title: Wheely 6
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Wheely 6 sends the little car into a fairy-tale story on a mission to rescue his girlfriend. Help Wheely by solving the puzzles that stand between him and the next part of his journey. Work out each solution to move the rescue adventure forward.

pages.title: Real Tennis Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Real Tennis Game puts you on court to compete for the Wimbledon title. Serve the ball, direct your returns, and try to win the exchanges against your opponent.

Serving uses a power bar that you stop with a click or touch. During play, mouse movement or a swipe sets the ball's direction and height, while holding the input increases shot power. Balance placement and power when deciding how to send the ball back across the court.

pages.title: WordOwl
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description:
WordOwl is a word-search puzzle built around hobbies. Look through the letters to locate words connected with leisure activities, using the theme to guide what you search for.

The challenge focuses on spotting vocabulary within the puzzle and separating the words you need from the surrounding letters.

pages.title: Super Hero Make Up Salon!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Give Blondie a summer makeover in Super Hero Make Up Salon! This beauty and dress-up game asks you to create a makeup look for the superheroine, then choose a costume to go with it. Combine the seasonal beauty theme with superhero styling as you arrange both parts of Blondie's new look.

pages.title: Gold Mine Strike Christmas
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Gold Mine Strike Christmas gives the Gold Strike formula a festive theme. Throw candy canes to clear packages and use powerups to help your progress.

The gold you collect pays for powerup upgrades, connecting your clearing efforts with stronger assistance later on. Keep removing packages and invest the gold you acquire in the powerups you want to improve.

pages.title: Princess New Years Resolutions
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Princess New Years Resolutions is a dress-up game that turns three princesses' plans for the coming year into outfit themes. Ariel wants to learn to cook, Elsa plans to spend more time reading, and Aurora wants to exercise more.

Help Ariel choose clothes for the kitchen, put together a comfortable library look for Elsa, and pick a gym outfit for Aurora. Match pieces from their wardrobes to each activity, moving between three different styles as you dress the princesses for their resolutions.

pages.title: City Heroes
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
City Heroes is a shooting defense game about stopping robots from invading the city. Move the mouse to aim and click to fire at the attackers. Hover over dropped coins to collect them as you fight through the stages.

Coins pay for upgrades such as faster firing and greater damage. Progress also introduces extra help, including an automatically firing hero and powers that launch missiles, throw a grenade, or place dynamite. Combine your regular gunfire with these abilities to destroy the enemy forces and defend the city.
